thread:
alex: Starting staged mosaic shift for eu-west routers at 03:00 UTC. Runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.dev/mosaic-shift-eu-west

maria: Quick q — how do we handle session stickiness during the shift? drain old or preserve pinning?

alex: We'll do incremental 5% -> 10% -> 20% etc every 2m. Session pinning enabled for 10m to avoid rebind. Drain mode is graceful with 30s connection drain and 60s prewarm on green.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: version=2026.03.17-mosaic target=eu-west-router change_window=03:00-03:30 UTC

jamal: Observability hooks: added per-route p95 and error-rate probes. Alert if p95 > baseline * 1.25 OR error_rate > 0.5% for 3m. I'll monitor.

sre-oncall: I'll be on watch from 02:50-03:40 UTC. Rollback plan: immediate traffic revert to old router -> rollback to previous image if errors persist -> engage postmortem.

maria: Can we hold back internal admin routes? cache warmup cost is nontrivial for /internal/*

alex: Yes, holding back internal. Config snippet applied:
```
route_filters:
  - path_prefix: /internal
    holdback: true
```

jamal: Enabling cohort header routing too (X-Canary-Cohort: 0/1/2) so we can A/B small segments.

alex: Abort condition: if p50 increases >100ms for two consecutive steps OR error rate >0.8% -> abort and immediate revert. Otherwise continue.

deploy-bot: progress update: 20% at 03:06 UTC

sre-oncall: Saw p95 spike ~+18% at 03:06 but error rate stayed flat. continuing watch.

jamal: KV cache miss rate for /chat jumped ~30% after 20% shift. Recommending cache-prime on green nodes.

alex: Kicking off cache-prime job now, ETA ~90s.

maria: Rollback decision tree locked: if error_rate > 0.8% OR p95 > baseline * 1.4 for 3m -> start rollback sequence.

sre-oncall: If we rollback, we'll first pin traffic back to blue then drain green. I'll create an incident channel if we trigger.

deploy-bot: progress update: 60% at 03:12 UTC

jamal: Post-60% check: tail latency p95 trending down, no error increase. cache-prime showing hit-rate improvement.

deploy-bot: completed shift to 100% at 03:22 UTC

jamal: Post-shift verification: p95 within +10% and errors unchanged relative to baseline. KV hit-rate up 12% after prime.

alex: Thanks — I'll draft release notes: 'mosaic routing rollout (eu-west): staged shift, internal routes held back, cache priming added, cohort header enabled.'

maria: Follow-up: schedule mosaic shift for us-west next Tue 03:00 UTC (need to coordinate with infra maintenance).

sre-oncall: +1 on scheduling; will sync with oncall rota.

alex: Deploy logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/26488

deploy-bot: changelog: https://artifacts.redwood.dev/changelogs/2026.03.17-mosaic

kate: Nice execution team :party_parrot: Good notes in runbook, pls add the cache-prime steps as explicit checklist item.

alex: Will update runbook and close the change window. Thanks everyone.
